chunks: Muhammad ibn Yahya, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Al-Husayn ibn Saeed, from Ahmad ibn Yazeed, from Abu Al-Hasan (peace be upon him) who said:
Eating the saltwort disinfects the mouth.

key_terms.الْأُشْنَانِ: Saltwort, a salt-water plant known for its medicinal and hygienic properties

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of eating saltwort according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: Recorded in *Al-Kafi* by Shaykh al-Kulayni, this hadith from Imam al-Rida (AS) highlights the practical medicinal benefits of the saltwort plant (*Ashnan*), noting its ability to purify the mouth and eliminate bad breath. This reflects the Shia tradition of integrating natural remedies with spiritual and physical well-being, emphasizing the Prophet's family's attention to daily hygiene as part of a holistic lifestyle.
